summary.text: A man aged 30 years, a habitual khat chewer with khat use of 10 bundle-years, was identified in Somaliland with cirrhosis of otherwise unknown cause. He presented with ascites, spontaneous bacterial peritonitis, hepatic encephalopathy. Common causes of cirrhosis, including alcohol, hepatotoxic medications and viral infection, were excluded by history, examination and testing.
Ultrasound showed Cirrhosis, splenomegaly. Laboratory results were ALT 118, AST 50, ALKP 352 and total bilirubin 2.8. He quit chewing khat. He died at home of upper GI haemorrhage.

Ultrasound showed Cirrhosis, splenomegaly. Laboratory results were ALT 20, AST 15, ALKP 522 and total bilirubin 5.5. He quit chewing khat. He improved without diuretics after stopping khat.

summary.text: A man aged 40 years, a habitual khat chewer with khat use of 128 bundle-years, was identified in Somaliland with cirrhosis of otherwise unknown cause. He presented with hepatic encephalopathy, hepatorenal syndrome. Common causes of cirrhosis, including alcohol, hepatotoxic medications and viral infection, were excluded by history, examination and testing.

Ultrasound showed Cirrhosis, ascites. Laboratory results were ALT 54, AST 42, ALKP 310 and total bilirubin 2.7. A liver biopsy was done to investigate the cause of cirrhosis and showed changes of chronic hepatitis with lobular cholestasis and advanced fibrosis, bridging fibrosis, and a single schistosome form; the pathology differential included autoimmune hepatitis, chronic viral hepatitis and drug effect. He quit chewing khat. He died at home of upper GI haemorrhage.

He presented with incarcerated umbilical hernia, ascites, spontaneous bacterial peritonitis. summary.text: A man aged 65 years, a habitual khat chewer with khat use of 40 bundle-years, was identified in Somaliland with cirrhosis of otherwise unknown cause. He presented with ascites, itching. Common causes of cirrhosis, including alcohol, hepatotoxic medications and viral infection, were excluded by history, examination and testing.

Ultrasound showed Cirrhosis, ascites. Laboratory results were ALT 35, AST 27, ALKP 243 and total bilirubin 1.5. He quit chewing khat. He improved initially and then died at home, with the cause printed as a question.
